broad_screen_failure.reason: R29 preregistered block digest convention did not equal reconstructed contiguous BF16 tensor digest at the first block; broad screen stopped before any block arm. No block result retained. Full source tensor hashes were independently verified and the full-tensor campaign proceeded.

claim_scope: actual stock EXL3 codec-exact full-tensor local calibration evidence; no validation KLD claim

postrun_correction.reason: Reviewer-corrected QMM/SNR labeling and callback aggregation for future reruns; measured numeric arm rows unchanged.

qmm.reason: The recorded last-callback Gaussian target-minus-error rate is an SNR-equivalent achieved-bit diagnostic, not oracle-minus-stock remaining headroom. It cannot be compared with the preregistered 0.1-bit QMM threshold.

blocker_corrections: Gaussian target-minus-error rate relabeled SNR-equivalent; QMM oracle marked not measured
Validation falsifier marked not triggered; no-action is conservative promotion gate

selection.reason: Local actual-stock evidence is negative: rho=1 stock minimizes real-input HWE on both promoted tensors; all interior rho and bands regress. Direct R31 validation KLD is unavailable, so the preregistered validation falsifier is not claimed as triggered. Conservative promotion gate selects no action.
selection.rule: No new action when an endpoint wins or an interior action lacks validation full-vocabulary KLD.
